title: 第318章 活观第317章 一嘴毛
slug: 模拟修仙杀我者恩人也
lines: 道观内的场景很奇怪，尸体不长毛，石像长了毛，狗不咬人，人追着狗咬。
庄稼汉站在门口，一只脚踩在门内，另一只脚留在了门外。
他脸上的表情很纠结，一边担心着师弟的安危，另一边又不想被干尸和野狗撕咬，把自己弄得浑身是血。
“咳咳~”
最后，庄稼汉咳嗽两声，慢慢蹲在门口，动都不动了。
地上流淌着粘稠的血浆，干尸发了狂，不停的撕咬石像。
石像上裂开的缝隙越来越多，一簇簇鲜红色的狗毛漫天飞舞，落满了整个庭院。
最后，石像被干尸掏空了。
一具干尸站在血泊里，浑身上下鲜血淋漓，沾满了狗毛。
它变成了一只毛茸茸的怪物，一动不动，只是站在那里。
道观后门，另一具干尸有些疑惑，盯着那个长满毛的同类，发出了一声呼喊。
“怎么了？”
“你这是犯了哪门子的病？”
毛尸没有回应，慢慢扭动身体，它的手掌心里握着一块黑漆漆的狗肉。
这块肉很硬，硬的像块石头，表面上长了很多毛，闻起来就令人作呕。
在庄稼汉和干尸的注视下，毛尸伸出手，把长毛的狗肉塞进了嘴里，然后吞咽进了腹中。
庄稼汉啧啧称奇：“这你也吃得下去。”
干尸却眼神奇怪，不知道在想什么。
片刻后，
毛尸身上发生了更加诡异的变化，它的身体迅速膨胀，转瞬间就变成了两人高。
毛尸口中尖牙外露，瞳孔变成了刺眼的鲜红色，浑身的毛发越长越长。
道观开始晃动，刺鼻的血腥气越来越浓。
随着一声嘶吼，毛尸猛然转过身，盯上了堵在后面的干尸。
干尸脸色剧变，转身想逃出道观。
但它一转头，撞在了道观的后门上，木门吱嘎作响……没有被撞开。
干尸愣了愣，这门怎么会这么坚硬，比墙上的石头还沉重。
而且后门上了锁，从里面根本打不开。
眼下情况危急，来不及细想，毛尸已经迈开脚步，把干尸堵在了门前的角落里。
“你发什么疯！”
干尸还想挣扎，对着毛尸大喊道：“别忘了我们之间的约定，你敢对我下手，它们绝对不会放过你。”
content_en:
The scene in the Taoist temple is very strange. The corpses have no hair, but the stone statues have hair. Dogs don't bite people, but people chase and bite the dogs.
The farmer stood at the door, with one foot on the inside and the other on the outside.
The expression on his face was very complicated. On the one hand, he was worried about his junior brother's safety, but on the other hand, he didn't want to be bitten by mummies and wild dogs, making himself covered in blood.
"Ahem~"
Finally, the farmer coughed twice and slowly squatted at the door, unable to move.
…
There was thick blood flowing on the ground, and the mummy went crazy, biting the stone statue.
There were more and more cracks on the stone statue, and clusters of bright red dog hair were flying in the sky, covering the entire courtyard.
Finally, the stone statue was hollowed out by the mummy.
A mummy stood in a pool of blood, covered in blood and covered with dog hair.
It turned into a furry monster, motionless, just standing there.
At the back door of the Taoist temple, another mummy looked confused, staring at the hairy fellow, and let out a cry.
"What's wrong?"
"What kind of disease do you have?"
The furry corpse didn't respond and slowly twisted its body. It held a piece of dark dog meat in its palm.
This piece of meat was very hard, as hard as a rock, with a lot of hair growing on the surface, and the smell was disgusting.
Under the gaze of the farmer and the mummy, the hairy corpse stretched out his hand, stuffed the long-haired dog meat into his mouth, and then swallowed it.
The farmer exclaimed, "You can even eat this."
But the mummy had strange eyes and didn't know what he was thinking.
After a while,
An even weirder change took place on the body of the hairy corpse. Its body expanded rapidly, and in an instant it became two people tall.
The fangs in the hairy corpse's mouth were exposed, the pupils turned into a dazzling bright red, and the hair all over the body grew longer and longer.
The Taoist temple began to shake, and the pungent smell of blood became stronger and stronger.
"Roar!"
With a roar, the hairy corpse turned around suddenly and stared at the mummy blocking the back.
The mummy's expression changed drastically, and he turned around to escape from the Taoist temple.
But it turned its head and hit the back door of the Taoist temple. The wooden door creaked... but was not knocked open.
The mummy was stunned. How could this door be so hard? It was heavier than the stones on the wall.
And the back door was locked and couldn't be opened from the inside.
The situation was critical at the moment, and before I had time to think about it, the corpse had already taken steps and blocked the mummy in the corner in front of the door.
"Why are you crazy!"
The mummy still wanted to struggle and shouted to the furry corpse: "Don't forget the agreement between us. If you dare to attack me, they will never let you go."
title_en: Chapter 318: Living Observation Chapter 317: A Mouth of Hair
